items.source: Gets a new fully configured but paused WebServer instance. Clients should not be able to connect to the returned server until WebServer.start() is called (which happens when the ApplicationContext has been fully refreshed).
items.translation: 获取一个新的已完全配置但处于暂停状态的WebServer实例。客户端不应在调用WebServer.start()（这发生在ApplicationContext完全刷新之后）之前连接到返回的服务器。

items.source: a fully configured and started WebServer
items.translation: 一个完全配置并启动的WebServer

items.source: Factory interface that can be used to create a reactive WebServer.
items.translation: 用于创建响应式WebServer的工厂接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
